properties.name: backdrop
properties.description: Changes the opacity of the backdrop

design.name: 👁️ Show Backdrop
design.note: Only toggles the presence of the backdrop. The strong and weak appearance is set on the nested Backdrop instance, while the code prop `backdrop` covers presence and appearance in one enum.

properties.name: containerSize
properties.description: Maximum inline size of the dialog

design.name: 🔀 Content Behavior
design.note: Design-only variant that depicts the scroll behaviour in mockups. In code the content area scrolls automatically once the content exceeds the available height, so there is no matching prop.

design.name: 📦 Start Slot
design.note: In Figma the slot belongs to the nested Popover instance and is not exposed as a property of the Dialog component set.
